purpose: Convert proof-obligation quantities into executable metrics suitable for simulation, statistical testing, and falsification.

governance_note.important: These are operational metrics, not ontological definitions.
governance_note.meaning: A metric may later be replaced while the underlying concept remains unchanged.

C_orient.name: Orientation Coherence
C_orient.concept: Degree to which orientation references remain mutually consistent across closure candidates.

S_closure.name: Closure Stability
S_closure.concept: Persistence of a closure structure through update cycles.

R_support.name: Residue Support
R_support.concept: Influence of accumulated residue on closure persistence.

A_width.name: Admissibility Width
A_width.concept: Effective admissible transition volume available to a structure.

T_preserve.name: Topology Preservation
T_preserve.concept: Degree to which connectivity survives perturbation.
